work.description: Indult CLXXVI granting insignia to the canons of the collegiate church of the Annunziata at Andria; protocol 28404–28405, Datum 28507–28510 at top of page 202, before numeral CLXXVII 28513. Internal gaps are running titles, page numbers, signatures and provenance citations only. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF28404. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
